“The weed is a plant whose virtues have not yet been discovered.”

Ralph Waldo Emerson
______________________________________________________________

“Dandelion juice is truly a natural stimulant for the liver to produce more free-flowing bile. On the whole, the general well-being induced by taking this juice is due to the stimulation of the entire metabolism as well as the liver cells. This is achieved through the wealth of minerals contained in the plant.”

Siegfried Gursche – Healing with Herbal Juices (Alive Books).Vol 18 Issue 1 page 2
